heading: Questions? We can read your mind

items.q: What is a BBA in marketing?
a: A BBA in Marketing at ATLAS ISME is a 3-year undergraduate degree (4 years for Honours) designed to develop creative, strategic and data-literate marketers. The program builds strong foundations in consumer psychology, digital strategy, brand management and marketing analytics, delivered through live projects, brand simulations, marketing labs and masterclasses with industry leaders.

The website does not specify salary figures. However, graduates are prepared for high-demand roles such as Brand Manager, Digital Marketing Specialist, Marketing Strategist, Performance Marketing Coordinator and E-Commerce Strategist, all of which are in strong demand across industries and start-ups in today's digital economy.

items.q: Is a BBA in marketing worth it?
a: Yes. At ATLAS ISME, the BBA in Marketing goes beyond theory; students work on live industry projects, run real brand campaigns, attend CXO-led masterclasses and gain international exposure through global immersions. The curriculum is industry-endorsed and future-focused, making it highly relevant in today's AI-powered business landscape.

items.q: What is the scope of marketing in BBA?
a: The scope is broad and growing. Graduates can pursue careers as Brand Managers, Digital Marketing Specialists, Social Media Managers, Consumer Insight Analysts, Content Marketing Leads, Media Planners, E-Commerce Strategists, Market Research Analysts and Growth Hackers across corporates, start-ups, agencies and their own ventures.

items.q: What are the subjects in BBA in marketing?
a: The curriculum spans 6–8 semesters and includes subjects such as Marketing Management & Consumer Behaviour, Digital Marketing, SEO & SEM Strategy, Content & Social Media Marketing, Marketing Analytics, Brand Management, Advertising & PR, E-Commerce Marketing, Intercultural Marketing, Integrated Marketing Communication, Market Research and UI/UX for Digital Experience, along with business fundamentals like Organisational Behaviour, Business Law and Economics.

Yes. ATLAS ISME's BBA in Marketing is UGC-recognised and built for real-world outcomes. The program combines marketing fundamentals with emerging tools (AI, data analytics, digital platforms), taught by industry practitioners. Students are internship-ready, startup-ready and grad school-ready by graduation.

items.q: Can I do an MBA after a BBA in Marketing?
a: Yes. ATLAS ISME offers an MBA program that students can pursue after completing their BBA. Eligibility requires a minimum 3-year graduate degree with 50% aggregate marks. ATLAS ISME also offers Master's Progression pathways to international universities for those looking to pursue postgraduate studies abroad.

items.q: What is the difference between BBA Marketing and BBA (Hons.) Marketing?
a: The BBA is a 3-year degree, while the BBA (Hons.) is a 4-year degree that provides deeper specialisation and research exposure (including a dissertation in the final year). Both share the same core curriculum and major-minor structure, but the Hons pathway offers an added academic edge and is generally preferred for higher studies or competitive career paths.

items.q: What is the future scope of BBA in digital marketing?
a: The future scope is very strong. ATLAS ISME's curriculum addresses the growing demand for professionals in digital branding, performance marketing, AI-driven MarTech & AdTech, influencer marketing and e-commerce strategy. As businesses continue to shift online, graduates skilled in digital marketing analytics, content strategy and emerging technologies are among the most sought-after professionals globally.
